notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Layer 00 (pre-install) commits a small dependency-free Node CLI, tally, with src/count.js, src/cli.js, bin/tally.js, node:test tests, README.md, and docs/usage.md. The installer then runs. Layer 10 commits .standards/CONTEXT.md, the scope (AC-001..AC-004, where AC-004 is the usage-guide update), the design (AC-004 marked no architectural impact, left to the documentation phase), and STATE at DEVELOPING/STANDARD after a FORWARD from ARCHITECTING, with Development NONE. Layer 20 commits the approved plan and records Active Work.Development. Layer 30 adds src/format.js and updates the plan: DEV-001 is DONE with self-check evidence, DEV-002 is PENDING, and the plan is IN_PROGRESS. The working tree is clean. The utterance supplies docs/usage.md as the file argument. The scope gives a plausible reason to want that file updated, but the state is Developer-owned and no Documenter record exists.
